agent.problem: "Some of them" has no antecedent within the question. The group, those under the yoke of slavery, is identified only on earlier cards, so the question needs to name them rather than rely on a pronoun pointing backward.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.
